text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis left for a one-day visit to Finland to discuss the results of Russian-U.S. summit and biulteral relation,
- Head of Latvian Social Democratic Workers' Party Juris Bojars sues MP Andris Shkele for defamation, demanding 1,000 lat in compensation.
- WEU secretary general Jose Cutiliero continues his two-day visit to Latvia.
- The Latvian real estate agency says there is a growing interest among foreigners to buy into Latvia.
- Blizzards and strong winds caused damage to low-voltage electricity networks and cut in supply, especially in the eastern region of Latgale, but spared the main grid.
